title: slot-claim decoder cannot carry a signature; has_signature has no setter; resource fail-closed dead silently
description: coap_slot_coord.c:800-856 decode_claim parses no signature/COSE field and include/lichen/coap_slot_coord.h:121 has_signature has zero setters repo-wide — it can only be false. A claim carrying a sig/signature key hits the unknown-key branch (:845-848) -> -EBADMSG -> 4.00. Every POST dies at LICHEN_CLAIM_REJECT_NO_SIG -> silent return 0 (:1027-1029) with only LOG_DBG (:301, compiled out at default level). Spec-conformant gateways can never claim and operators get no signal; the silent-discard policy masks a protocol bug as indistinguishable-from-attack. Fix: extend the claim format to carry the GCP-6.5 envelope (unblocks the signature-coverage fix), set has_signature, log discards at WARN with rate limiting. Land together with the signature-coverage bead.
close_reason: Obsolete: superseded by nwjl.3; COSE_Sign1 envelope makes has_signature structurally redundant. Bead's own comment confirms.
